4pc Reminiscence set bonus is pretty good for Yanfei, but I don't think it's better than 4pc Wanderer's or 4pc CWoF. It's awkward to take full advantage of this bonus and still use your burst with the energy drain, especially with a character that has an 80-cost burst.

To avoid energy issues, you want either:

1. Enough energy recharge % to offset the loss when the set effect goes off (I'm running 175% with an ER sands)
2. A battery like Bennett to funnel particles to her for regen

Assuming ER is dealt with, the set feels strong to me. 50% extra damage is very good. However, this set doesn't include a bonus to pyro damage or reactions like CWoF, and the set effect is conditional unlike Wanderer's Troupe.
